st: I Won't Run Away from Love Anymore: Ami vs. Mamoru
d: The Dark Kingdom is trying to revive the Seven Great Monsters. Sailor Mercury and Jupiter scramble to protect Ryo Urawa.

st: Sailor Venus's Past: Minako's Tragic Love
d: Minako receives a surprise visit from Katarina, Minako’s former partner. A tragic incident forced them to go their separate ways.

st: Usagi Abandoned: The Falling-Out of the Sailor Guardians
d: Sailor Moon and the other Sailor Guardians appear to have a falling-out. But it’s all part of the plan to locate the enemy’s hideout.

st: Usagi's Awakening: A Message from the Distant Past
d: Sailor Venus finds the Dark Kingdom's hideout. The Sailor Guardians fall into Kunzite’s trap, which hurls them into the past.

st: Death of the Sailor Guardians: The Tragic Final Battle
d: The Sailor Guardians head into the Arctic Circle. Queen Beryl sends the DD Girls. The Sailor Guardians fall as they try to defeat the DD Girls.

st: Usagi's Eternal Wish: A Brand New Life
d: Sailor Moon attempts to free Endymion from Queen Beryl’s control. Sailor Moon is forced to fight the man she loves.

st: Moon Returns: The Mysterious Aliens Appear
d: Having lost all memory of being Sailor Moon, Usagi now lives her life as an ordinary girl.

st: For Love and for Justice: Sailor Guardians Once Again
d: Sailor Moon finds herself facing new enemies from outer space. The two aliens disguise themselves as humans to go after other human energy.

st: For Whom Is the White Rose? The Moonlight Knight Appears
d: Usagi, Mako, and Ami see a boy attacked by one of Ail and An’s Cardian monsters. To Mako’s surprise, the boy turns out to be her childhood friend.

st: Usagi's Crisis: The Tiara Stops Working
d: Usagi goes to a virtual reality arcade in the Juban District, where she unexpectedly runs into Mamoru, as well as Seijuro and Natsumi.

st: A New Transformation: Usagi's Power-Up
d: Usagi and her friends are enjoying the cherry blossoms when the Cardian Leshy attacks. The Sailor Guardians are caught.

st: The Targeted Kindergarteners: Venus to the Rescue
d: Minako befriends a little girl named Mie who is a huge fan of Sailor Moon. Meanwhile, Ail and An send a Cardian to steal energy from young children.

st: Mamoru and Usagi's Babysitting Mayhem
d: Usagi and Mamoru find themselves looking after a baby boy while his mother is recovering from having her energy stolen by a Cardian.

st: The School Festival Is for Me?! Queen Rei's Song
d: A school festival is going to be held at T.A. Girls’ Academy, which Rei attends. Usagi and Ami go to check up on her.

st: Is Seijuro the Moonlight Knight? Mako on Fire
d: Ami and Makoto are trying to figure out who the Moonlight Knight is. Makoto volunteers to investigate by getting closer to Seijuro.

st: Steal a Kiss from Mamoru: An's Project Snow White
d: Usagi and the girls get into an argument over who gets to play Snow White in the upcoming play with Mamoru.

st: After-School Trouble: Usagi Is a Target
d: Usagi and Natsumi both get detention after angering Ms. Haruna during class. The two start working on their assignment when a Cardian shows up.

st: Disconnecting Love: The Raging Makai Tree
d: Ail and An learn that the Makai Tree is beginning to die. Usagi and her friends visit Natsumi after hearing that Natsumi is not feeling well.

st: True Love Awakens: The Makai Tree's Secret
d: While visiting Seijuro and Natsumi's apartment, Usagi and Mamoru come under attack by the Makai Tree.

st: Angel or Devil? The Mysterious Girl from the Sky
d: A mysterious girl suddenly falls down from the sky. Calling herself 'Usagi,' the girl demands Usagi to tell her where the Silver Crystal is.

st: Usagi Devastated: Mamoru Declares a Break-Up
d: Usagi wakes up to find that Chibi-Usa has gone missing. Meeting up with Mamoru, the two search for Chibi-Usa, finding her alone at the park.

st: A Guardian's Friendship: Goodbye, Ami
d: Ami is offered a chance to study abroad in Germany. Knowing how important this is to her, Usagi and the others urge Ami to accept the offer.

st: Women Must Be Strong and Beautiful: Rei's New Special Technique
d: Rei's grandfather is upset that Hikawa Shrine has had fewer female visitors lately. He then decides to retire as head priest to start a new business.

st: In Search of the Silver Crystal: Chibi-Usa's Secret
d: Rubeus sends down Petz and her Droid to search and capture Chibi-Usa. Chibi-Usa is calling someone telling her she wants to go home.

st: Dispute Over Love: Minako and Makoto's Conflict
d: Minako and Makoto clash over their opposing views on love. Usagi takes the girls to a accessory shop, unaware that Petz and Calaveras run the place.

st: Usagi's Parental Love: The Curry Romance Triangle
d: Chibi-Usa's class is having a parent-child curry party. After hearing that neither Kenji nor Ikuko can attend, Usagi decides to go in their place.

st: The Beach, the Island and a Vacation: The Guardians' Break
d: The girls enjoy some vacation time on an island. Chibi-Usa and Rei get into a small fight, causing an angry Chibi-Usa to go out to the sea alone.

st: Protect Chibi-Usa: Clash of the Ten Warriors
d: Chibi-Usa leaves the house after being scolded by Usagi. Chibi-Usa begins to cry, which draws the attention of Rubeus and the Four Spectre Sisters.

st: Awaken the Sleeping Beauty: Mamoru's Distress
d: Mamoru has a dream which a voice warns him that being with Usagi will bring her great misfortune. Meanwhile, Sailor Moon is attacked by a Droid.

st: Battle of the Flames of Love! Mars vs. Koan
d: Wiseman predicts that Chibi-Usa will appear at Hikawa Shrine. Learning of this, Rubeus orders Koan to go down there and eliminate their target.

st: For Friendship: Ami vs. Bertheir
d: Ami enters the World Chess Tournament, but Bertheir is also there, forcing Ami to transform and reveal her identity as a Sailor Guardian to the enemy.

st: Rubeus the Heartless: The Tragic Sisters
d: Rubeus gives Petz and Calaveras one last chance to eliminate Rabbit and the Sailor Guardians once and for all.

st: A UFO Appears: The Sailor Guardians Abducted
d: Chibi-Usa learns that Usagi is Sailor Moon. Eager to return to the future, she steals Usagi's Silver Crystal and flees, only to be ambushed by Rubeus.

st: Defeat Rubeus: The Battle in Space
d: Rubeus succeeds in taking four of the five Sailor Guardians prisoner. He demands that Sailor Moon bring Chibi-Usa and the Silver Crystal to him.
